provenance: Local tabletop layout using unchanged EBiM connector/post assets and cable material parameters; not official EBiM scoring
end_connection: First segment fixed; last endpoint connected to the second fixed socket, free to rotate. No gripper attachment or clip capture force.

scoring.description: From connector 0 to 1, pass three Y cross-sections on the +X side of post 0 then the -X side of post 1, below their top caps; hold 0.3 s. Clip insertion is diagnostic only in this layout.
